d: Short, straight pale pink hair with blunt bangs and a soft texture. Sharp, narrow light-blue eyes with a calm, detached expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a black military-style jacket with teal lining, a black collared undershirt, a black belt, white high-waisted tights, and metallic silver boots with black guards. Accessories include white gloves, a small black hair clip, and a large, futuristic black and silver mechanical weapon held in one hand.
